title: straw-boss-desk stack.json
description: The tool and package pins of the stack. Every download has a URL and a SHA256 per platform; every npm package has an exact version and its registry integrity. A candidate stack.json is signed as a detached Ed25519 signature over its exact bytes (stack.json.sig), so nothing in this file carries the signature.

schema.description: The format version of this file. An app that does not know it refuses the file.

generation.description: Increases with every published stack.json; the app applies a candidate only when it is higher than the active one.

minShell.description: The lowest shell version that can apply this stack.

optionalTools.description: Tools installed only when the active recipe names them in its tools list (recipe spec, section 5). The set is closed like tools: a new optional tool is a schema change. The names are what a recipe may list.

npmGlobal.description: Packages installed into the private npm prefix, with their bin name. An optional one is installed later, not in the first install.

profile.description: The team profile package. A recipe's profile pin wins over this entry.

exactVersion.description: One exact version: three or four numeric parts, an optional pre-release or build suffix. No range, tag, or wildcard.

integrity.description: The registry's dist.integrity: sha512- and the base64 of the 64-byte digest.

file.description: The name the download is kept under; the last segment of url. It does not start with `-`: tar would read `-` as stdin.

optionalTool.description: A tool entry that a recipe can turn on. The note is required: it says why this build was chosen, because a variant that differs by platform (a baseline build, an emulation caveat) is a decision a later pin update must keep.

npmVersion.description: One exact semver version of a registry package.
